3.28
```{r}
load("C:/Users/jaspe/OneDrive/Desktop/R code/poe5rdata/motel.rdata")
head(motel)
```
(a)
```{r}
motel$relprice2 <- 100 * motel$relprice
plot(motel$time, motel$relprice, type="o", col="blue",  xlab="Time", ylab="Reprice2")

summary_stats <- summary(motel$relprice2)
print(summary_stats)
sd_val <- sd(motel$relprice2)
```
(b)
```{r}
model <- lm(motel_pct ~ relprice2, data = motel)
summary(model)

confint(model, "relprice2", level = 0.95)
```
(c)
```{r}
new_data <- data.frame(relprice2 = 80)
predict(model, new_data, interval = "confidence", level = 0.90)
```
(d)
```{r}
t_stat <- summary(model)$coefficients["relprice2", "t value"]
p_val_one_tailed <- pt(t_stat, df = df.residual(model))
cat("t 統計量:", t_stat, "單尾 p-value:", p_val_one_tailed)
```
(e)
```{r}
beta_hat <- coef(model)["relprice2"]
se_beta <- summary(model)$coefficients["relprice2", "Std. Error"]
t_val_e <- (beta_hat - (-1)) / se_beta
p_val_e <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_val_e), df = df.residual(model))
cat("檢定 beta2 = -1 的 t 值:", t_val_e, "p 值:", p_val_e)
```

3.31
```{r}
load("C:/Users/jaspe/OneDrive/Desktop/R code/poe5rdata/tuna.rdata")
head(tuna)
```
(a)
```{r}

summary(tuna[c("sal1", "apr1")])
sd_sal1 <- sd(tuna$sal1)
sd_apr1 <- sd(tuna$apr1)

n <- nrow(tuna)
weeks <- 1:n

plot(weeks, tuna$sal1, type = "l",  main="每週銷售量 sal1", xlab="Week", ylab="Sales")
plot(weeks, tuna$apr1, type = "l", main="每週價格 apr1", xlab="Week", ylab="Price")
```
(b)
```{r}
plot(tuna$apr1, tuna$sal1, main="銷售量與價格的關係", 
     xlab="價格 (APR1)", ylab="銷售量 (SAL1)", pch=19)
```
(c)
```{r}
tuna$price1 <- 100 * tuna$apr1
model_tuna <- lm(sal1 ~ price1, data = tuna)
summary(model_tuna)

confint(model_tuna, "price1", level = 0.95)
```
(d)
```{r}
new_price <- data.frame(price1 = 70)
predict(model_tuna, new_price, interval = "confidence", level = 0.90)
```
(e)
```{r}
beta2_hat <- coef(model_tuna)["price1"]
mean_price <- mean(tuna$price1)
mean_sales <- mean(tuna$sal1)

elasticity_mean <- beta2_hat * (mean_price / mean_sales)

ci_beta2 <- confint(model_tuna, "price1", level = 0.95)
ci_elasticity <- ci_beta2 * (mean_price / mean_sales)

cat("平均值處的彈性:", elasticity_mean, "\n")
cat("彈性的 95% 信賴區間:", ci_elasticity)
```
(f)
```{r}
target_beta2 <- -3 * (mean_sales / mean_price)
se_beta2 <- summary(model_tuna)$coefficients["price1", "Std. Error"]

t_stat_f <- (beta2_hat - target_beta2) / se_beta2
p_val_f <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_stat_f), df = df.residual(model_tuna))

cat("檢定 H0: epsilon = -3 的 t 統計量:", t_stat_f, "p 值:", p_val_f)
```
